P.name: Doom 'n Gloom
P.title: Template:Data Vex/Doom 'n Gloom
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Doom 'n Gloom|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Vex |skill = I |blurbicon = Vex Doom 'n Gloom.png |icon = false |icon2 = Vex Doom 'n Gloom.png |blurb = {{sbc|Passive - Doom:}} Periodically, {{ci|Vex}} empowers her next basic ability to {{tip|knockdown|knock down}} and briefly {{tip|flee|fear}} enemies hit. |blurb2 = {{sbc|Innate - Gloom:}} Nearby enemies that {{tip|dash}} or {{tip|blink}} become marked with ''Gloom'' for a few seconds. '''Vex's''' next basic attack or basic ability hit will consume the mark to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and {{sti|cdr|reduce}} ''Doom's'' cooldown.
''{{ai|Looming Darkness|Vex}}'' will also inflict ''Gloom'', but cannot detonate it. |description = {{sbc|Passive - Doom:}} Periodically, '''Vex''' empowers her next {{tip|ability|basic ability}} to {{tip|knockdown|knock down}} and {{tip|fear}} enemies hit for {{pp|0.75 to 1.5 for 4|1;6;9;13}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by {{pp|type=distance from '''Vex'''|60 to 99 for 11|250 to 800|key=%|formula=60% + 3.9% for every 55 units away from Vex}}. If ''{{ai|Looming Darkness 2|Vex|Looming Darkness}}'' triggers ''Doom'', enemies hit will {{tip|flee}} from the epicenter instead.
''Doom's'' {{sti|cooldown}} resets upon [[death|respawning]]. |description2 = {{sbc|Innate - Gloom:}} Nearby enemy {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} that {{tip|dash}} or {{tip|blink}} will be marked with ''Gloom'' for 6 seconds. '''Vex's''' next {{tip|basic attack}}, which becomes {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}}, or basic ability hit against an enemy with ''Gloom'' will detonate the mark. ''{{ai|Looming Darkness|Vex}}'' will also inflict ''Gloom'', but cannot detonate it. |description3 = ''Gloom's'' detonation deals {{pp|40 + (150-40)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} and refunds 25% of ''Doom's'' cooldown. Against non-champions, this instead deals {{pp|40 to 60 for 5|1;6;9;13;16|key=%}} damage and refunds 10% of ''Doom's'' cooldown. |static = {{pp|25 to 16 for 4|1;6;11;16}} |cast time = |cost = |costtype = |effect radius= {{tt|1600|Dash and blink detection radius}} |width = |speed = |targeting = Passive |damagetype = Magic |projectile = false |affects = Self, Enemies |spelleffects = proc |onhiteffects = |spellshield = special |parry = true |callforhelp = |notes = * ''Gloom'' will mark {{ui|Rift Herald}} and {{ui|Rift Scuttler}} when they use their dashes. * ''Gloom'' can mark {{tip|clone|clones}}, but not other {{tip|pet|pets}}. * ''Gloom's'' mark has a very brief cooldown and refreshes on subsequent dashes or blinks nearby enemies use. * ''Gloom's'' mark duration will refresh to {{fd|0.5}} seconds when '''Vex''' starts an attack windup against a target that has a mark which is about to expire. * ''Gloom'' will mark enemies even if they are {{tip|untargetable}}. * ''Gloom'' will mark enemies that are inside the detection radius when they blink, but will not mark those that blink inside from far away.{{bug|2}} * ''Doom's'' cooldown starts as soon as the basic ability is cast. * ''Doom's'' {{tip|flee|fear}} will not be removed when '''Vex''' dies, unlike any other {{tip|flee|fear}} in the game.{{bug}} * Non-champions (e.g. {{ui|Rift Scuttler}}) are not {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by the fear-empowered ability.{{bug|2}} * {{tip|Spell shield}} will block all of ''Doom's'' effects but not ''Gloom's'' empowered attack nor mark. * Nearby enemies that become displaced do not count for being marked by ''Gloom''. * {{cais|Soul Unbound|Yone}} recast does not cause the caster to be marked by ''Gloom''.{{bug}} * '''Vex's''' basic abilities use a different icon when ''Doom'' is ready: ** [[File:Vex Mistral Bolt 2.png|20px|border]] Mistral Bolt ** [[File:Vex Personal Space 2.png|20px|border]] Personal Space ** [[File:Vex Looming Darkness 2.png|20px|border]] Looming Darkness }}
